notes_global: Light-vehicle 2026 tariffs. price = cheaper common case (telepeaje / off-peak / weekday / normal season); price_high = pricier variant (cash / peak / weekend / high season). model=ticket => price is the full end-to-end telepeaje traversal, NOT per-gate. Coordinates = nearest OSM barrier=toll_booth node (audited 2026-07-19). 34 entries = 100% ES coverage (20 state AGE/SEITT + 5 Catalonia + 2 Galicia + 1 Navarra + 3 Gipuzkoa + 3 Bizkaia); state list cross-checked vs ministry release of 30-12-2025.

tolls.name: AP-6 Villalba–Adanero
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full Villalba-Adanero ligeros 15.70 EUR (single tarifa general, no time variation). Villalba-San Rafael 5.65, Villalba-Villacastin 10.10. Coord approx San Rafael.

tolls.name: AP-51 (conexión AP-6 – Ávila)
tolls.notes: Dynamic time-of-day (Valle/Normal/Punta). Full run 1.05 Valle / 1.75 Normal / 2.90 Punta; Villacastin-Avila 1.10/1.75/2.95. price=Valle 1.05, price_high=Punta 2.95 (highest ligeros).

tolls.name: AP-61 (conexión AP-6 – Segovia)
tolls.notes: Dynamic time-of-day (Valle/Normal/Punta). Full run El Espinar-Segovia 1.95 Valle / 2.95 Normal / 4.80 Punta. price=Valle, price_high=Punta.

tolls.name: AP-53 Santiago–Alto de Santo Domingo
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full Santiago-Alto de Santo Domingo 7.25 (single column, no time variation). Santiago-Silleda 4.35.

tolls.name: AP-66 Campomanes–León (Huerna)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Base Campomanes-Leon 16.20. Frequent-user dynamic discounts (RD 1083/2024): 1st-2nd pass -15% = 13.75; 5th+ -60% = 6.47. price=13.75 (first electronic trips), price_high=16.20 base.

tolls.name: AP-68 Bilbao–Zaragoza
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, long corridor. Full Bilbao-Zaragoza 39.90 (single column). Bilbao-Logrono 19.60, Bilbao-Tudela 30.00. Coord approx Logrono. STATE road (AGE) though it runs through Basque territory - do not also add via the Basque agent. CONCESSION ENDS 10-11 Nov 2026: state tolls lifted then; Bizkaia/Alava stretches expected to transfer to the Diputaciones with much lower 'tarifas sociales' (~-50%, news-corroborated, not yet official tariffs) - re-verify after Nov 2026.

tolls.name: AP-71 León–Astorga
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, day/night tariff. Full Leon-Astorga: night 2.50 (23:00-07:00), day 6.20 (07:00-23:00). price=night, price_high=day.

tolls.name: AP-9 Autopista do Atlántico (Ferrol–frontera portuguesa)
tolls.notes: CAVEAT: segmented closed system with free gaps - NO single Ferrol->Tui figure published. price 8.80 = largest single quoted OD (A Coruna-Santiago). Segment ODs: Fene-A Coruna 6.15; A Coruna-Santiago 8.80; Santiago-Pontevedra 7.55; Pontevedra-Vigo 5.05; Puxeiros-Tui 3.55 (full corridor ~31 summed). Vigo-O Morrazo & A Coruna-A Barcala exempt. Needs per-segment modelling for accuracy.

tolls.name: AP-46 Alto de las Pedrizas–Málaga
tolls.notes: Single open barrier Casabermeja. Ligeros temporada baja 4.35 / alta 6.60 (May-Oct + weekends + 17 Easter days, 06:00-24:00). FREE 00:00-06:00. price=low, price_high=high season.

tolls.name: AP-7 Málaga–Estepona (Ausol I)
tolls.notes: Barrier system (Calahonda + San Pedro de Alcantara). Full Malaga-Estepona ligeros: normal 9.55 / especial 15.50 (summer/peak). Malaga-Marbella 5.70 normal. price=normal, price_high=especial.

tolls.name: AP-7 Estepona–Guadiaro (Ausol II)
tolls.notes: Open barrier Manilva. Full Estepona-Guadiaro ligeros: normal 2.45 / especial 4.05. Acceso Manilva half (1.20/2.00). price=normal, price_high=especial.

tolls.name: AP-7 Alicante–Cartagena
tolls.notes: Closed, seasonal. Full traversal ligeros: temporada baja 5.70 / alta 10.20 (Jun-Sep + 17 Easter days). NB: AP-7 Circunvalacion de Alicante is FREE since 9-Dec-2025 - this is the separate Alicante-Cartagena concession.

tolls.name: Radial R-2 (Madrid Aeropuerto – Guadalajara)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full Aeropuerto-NII-Taracena: telepeaje 4.60 / cash 5.20. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT. Guadalajara N-NII-Taracena bonificado 100%.

tolls.name: Radial R-3 (Madrid – Arganda/A-3)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, 'Accesos de Madrid' concession (shared with R-5). Full M-40/M-602-Conexion A-3: telepeaje 3.05 / cash 3.40. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT. Note precios_web_* filename pattern.

tolls.name: Radial R-4 (Madrid M-50 – Ocaña/A-40)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full M-50-Ocana/A-40: telepeaje 5.50 / cash 6.15. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT. 8-point OD matrix in TOLLS_RUNBOOK.md.

tolls.name: Radial R-5 (Madrid – Navalcarnero/A-5)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, 'Accesos de Madrid' (shared with R-3). Full M-40/M-45-Conexion A-5: telepeaje 3.25 / cash 3.65. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT.

tolls.name: M-12 (Eje Aeropuerto)
tolls.notes: OPEN two-point toll (not a true OD matrix). Peaje Barajas 0.90/1.00 + Peaje Alcobendas 0.50/0.55. price 1.40/1.55 = COMPUTED sum of both points for full Barajas-Alcobendas; PDF prints no combined cell. Free 00:00-06:00.

tolls.name: AP-7 Cartagena – Vera
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full Vera-Cartagena: telepeaje 10.15 / cash 11.35. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT. Almeria-Murcia coast.

tolls.name: AP-36 (Ocaña – La Roda)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full Corral Almaguer-San Clemente: telepeaje 12.35 / cash 13.85. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT.

tolls.name: AP-41 (Madrid – Toledo)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Full R-5-Toledo: telepeaje 5.30 / cash 5.95. Free 00:00-06:00, 21% VAT.

tolls.name: Túnel del Cadí
tolls.operator: Tabasa / Túnels Barcelona Cadí (Generalitat de Catalunya)
tolls.notes: Flat, Categoria 2 (turismos) 14.56 non-resident/no-discount (2026, +2.82%). No time variation. 100% bonification for Alt Urgell/Cerdanya/Bergueda residents via Consell Comarcal + ViaT. Key Barcelona<->Andorra crossing. Coord approx south (Baga) portal.

tolls.name: Túnels de Vallvidrera
tolls.operator: Tabasa / Túnels Barcelona Cadí (Generalitat de Catalunya)
tolls.notes: Categoria 2 (turismos): off-peak 4.70 / peak 5.28 (2026, +2.99%). Peak = weekdays 07:30-10:30 & 17:00-21:00 only. Collserola tunnel Barcelona<->Sant Cugat.

tolls.name: C-16 Sant Cugat–Terrassa (Autema, barrera Les Fonts)
tolls.notes: Effective turismo fare: 1.43 Mon-Fri non-holiday (with dynamic ViaT/Satelise peak discount) / 3.19 weekends+holidays (2026, ~+2.98%). Free round-trip if same barrier both ways within 24h Mon-Fri with registered payment. Base gross tariff higher pre-discount (~2.45).

tolls.name: C-16 Terrassa–Manresa (Autema, troncal Sant Vicenç de Castellet)
tolls.notes: Effective turismo fare at Sant Vicenc de Castellet troncal: 5.81 Mon-Fri (dynamic-payment discount) / 9.76 weekends+holidays (2026, ~+2.96%). Same 24h round-trip + dynamic-payment scheme. Base gross ~4.88 pre-discount.

tolls.name: C-32 Castelldefels–El Vendrell (Autopista Pau Casals, inc. Túnels del Garraf)
tolls.notes: Closed ticket (OD), Categoria II turismos, from 1-Jan-2026, 21% VAT. Representative full fare = Vallcarca troncal 8.42 (this section CONTAINS the Tunels del Garraf - there is NO separate Garraf toll). Cubelles troncal 5.03, acceso Cubelles 2.69, acceso Calafell 0.79. 'Movilidad obligada' discount halves fare. price depends on entry/exit.

tolls.name: AG-55 A Coruña – Carballo (Costa da Morte)
tolls.notes: AUTONOMIC (Xunta), not on ministry state list. Full A Coruna-Carballo turismo 2.05. Segments 0.55/0.75/1.30/0.85. Peajes FROZEN for 2026. 21% VAT. Bonif: 25/50% round-trip 24h, 50% nocturno, 100% familia numerosa.

tolls.name: AG-57 Vigo – Baiona (Val Miñor)
tolls.notes: AUTONOMIC (Xunta). Full Vigo-Baiona turismo 1.75. Segments Vigo-Vincios 0.40, Vigo-Gondomar 0.90, Vigo-Nigran 1.20. Peaje FROZEN 2026. 21% VAT. Same bonif as AG-55.

tolls.name: AP-15 Autopista de Navarra (Tudela – Irurzun)
tolls.notes: OPEN barrier system (NOT closed ticket): 3 troncal plazas Sarasa 2.65/1.77, Tiebas 4.55/2.99, Marcilla 6.85/4.47 + ramp plazas Marcilla enlace 3.45/2.29, Zuasti 0.90/0.59 (base/registered Via-T). price 9.23 = full Irurzun-AP-68 with Via-T REGISTERED with AUDENASA (~35% off, any driver, in-person signup); price_high 14.05 = cash/unregistered. Round trip with return <72h: return leg free (4.615/leg). No time/season variation. 2026 tariffs: Acuerdo Gobierno de Navarra 23-12-2025 (BON 258). Concession ends 8-Jun-2029; Gobierno announced (Feb-2026) free for turismos after. Coord = Marcilla tronco plaza.

tolls.name: AP-8 Ermua – Behobia (Gipuzkoa)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, Gipuzkoa stretch only (Ermua/Bizkaia border - Behobia/French border, 75 km). Full Ermua-Behobia 11.52 (Ermua-Donostia 8.37 + Donostia-Behobia 3.15). Single tariff: no cash/telepeaje/peak difference; discounts are monthly TAG refunds (round-trip -0.59 at select plazas, progressive 25/55/75% from 6+ transits/month, 38.02 monthly cap). Bidegi 2026 tariff PDF (vigentes desde 01.01.2026). Coord approx Zarautz main plaza.

tolls.name: AP-1 Bergara – Etxabarri-Ibiña (Gipuzkoa)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket. Tolled Gipuzkoa section Bergara (AP-8 junction) - Etxabarri-Ibina (Alava border, Isuskitza tunnel), 31.9 km; beyond toward Vitoria/Burgos is state-run and FREE since Dec-2018. Full Bergara H/S-Etxabarri-Ibina 7.56; Arrasate-Etxabarri 6.79, Eskoriatza-Etxabarri 5.22. Single tariff, no variation. Bidegi 2026 PDF. Coord approx Etxabarri-Ibina plaza.

tolls.name: AP-636 Beasain – Bergara (autovía de Deskarga)
tolls.notes: FREE-FLOW, no booths: plate/TAG portals at Beasain, Ezkio, Deskarga + Antzuola semi-portal; mandatory for all motor vehicles except motorcycles (plate must be pre-registered with Bidegi if no Via-T). price 2.79 = COMPUTED sum of 3 segments: Beasain-Ormaiztegi 0.42 + Ormaiztegi-Zumarraga 0.82 + Legazpi/Urretxu-Bergara 1.55 (no printed full-run cell, like M-12). Single tariff. Coord mid-road.

tolls.name: AP-8 Galdakao – límite Gipuzkoa (Bizkaia)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, Bizkaia stretch (Galdakao/AP-68 junction - limite Gipuzkoa near Ermua). Full Accesos Oeste-Limite 5.93. ODs: Accesos Oeste-Ermua 4.60, -Abadino 3.30, -Iurreta 2.80, -Amorebieta-Etxano 1.05; Iurreta-Abadino FREE (0.00 kept in the 2026 decree). Single flat tariff, no peak/payment variation; OBE benefits are after-the-fact refunds (1.05 local-hop adjustment, EV -25%, Bizkaia-resident monthly subsidy DF 108/2025). Decreto Foral 147/2025 + Interbiak 2026 PDF. Coord mid-road.

tolls.name: Supersur / Variante Sur Metropolitana (Arrigorriaga – Santurtzi)
tolls.notes: Closed/ticket, southern Bilbao bypass Arrigorriaga-Santurtzi (~13.5 km). Full traversal 2.05 (Arrigorriaga-Bilbao Sur 1.20, Bilbao Sur-Santurtzi 1.20). Flat 24h single tariff: the 00:00-06:00 'tarifa 0' was ABOLISHED for 2026. Same OBE refunds as AP-8 Bizkaia. Decreto Foral 147/2025 + Interbiak 2026 PDF. Coord mid-road.

tolls.name: Túneles de Artxanda (Bilbao – Txorierri)
tolls.notes: Fixed per crossing, charged BOTH directions; barrier-free multi-lane free-flow gantries since 2023 (no booths). 1.55 light (2025: 1.50; night 'tarifa 0' also abolished 2026 - now charged 24h). EV -25% with OBE. Tunel 2 (Ugasko/Deusto-Txorierri) closed from 3-Feb-2026 ~6 months for works - all traffic via Tunel 1 (La Salve). Decreto Foral 147/2025 + Interbiak 2026 PDF. Coord approx La Salve (Bilbao) portal.
